To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of 300 mM mannito to MS medium containing 6-benziladenine (BA) and indol-3-butyrate acid (IBA) to leaf disks of Mentha piperita (peppermint) and M. x piperita x M. aquatica (spearmint) improved the percentage of regeneration of shoots in vitro.
mannitol, 6-benziladenine and thidiazurin are effective for in vitro shoot regeneration of peppermint and spearmin leaf disks.
the addition of mannitol and thidazuron improves the efficiency of regeneration from leaf disks of spearmint and mint.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the improvement of in vitro shoot regeneration of peppermint and its close relative spearmint.
the improvement of plant growth in vitro and with plant regeneration from leaf disks.
the improvement of in vitro shoot organogenesis in Mentha x piperita L. and Mentha spicata L., and the optimization of culture conditions for genetic transformation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of 2.5 mM mannitol and 0.1 μM thidazuron to the culture medium containing 2 μM 6-BA and 0.2 μM NAA resulted in a high regeneration rate of 90.6%.
mannitol and thidazuron improve shoot regeneration of spearmint and pepperment in vitro.
the use of thidiazuron and mannitol in the culture medium was essential to achieve the best results in the in vitro regeneration of peppermint and peppermint leaf explants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a regeneration system that is suitable for the genetic transformation of spearmint and to a lesser extent, peppermint.
we have established a reliable protocol for in vitro shoot regeneration and that we have demonstrated the potential of the method for genetic engineering.
we developed an efficient in vitro shoot organogenesis protocol for the production of peppermint and spearmin plants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of mannitol to culture medium can be used as an alternative to the addition of growth retardants to improve in vitro shoot organogenesis.
mannitol is a good osmoticum for the regeneration of leaf disks of spearmint and that thidiazuron is an efficient cytokinin for in vitro shoot regeneration of both peppermint and spearnint.
the use of mannitol and thidazuron in the regeneration medium is crucial for the regeneration of shoots from peppermint and speamint leaf disks.
